Dublin Ranch Golf Club Wedding DJ

Mr & Mrs Tiffany & Lance Scott

Date: February 15th 2014
Location: 5900 Signal Hill Drive Dublin, CA 94568

Beautiful day for a Wedding, Not to hot or cold in Dublin, Bay Area, CA.


Ceremony

1. Background music
2. Seating of the parents-Officiant – Groomsman March. ( Christina Perri-Thousand Years )
3. Wedding Party March-Flower Gir l- Ring Bearer – Maid of Honor ( Corinne Bailey Rae- Like a Star )
4. Processional : Bride Walks Down the Aisle ( Adele- Make you feel my love )
5. Vows
6. Recessional Bride and Groom are Married Hitched Special Momments
that Last Forever! ( IZ- Over the Rainbow )

 

East Bay Wedding Reception DJ Music(Timeline for Wedding Receptions)
1. Cocktail Hour
2. Arrival of the Wedding Party Grand Entrance – ( Bruno Marz- Marry You ) Announce – Mr & Mrs Lance Scott
Newlyweds Applause
3. Wedding Jazz Background Type – Dinner Is Served-Dinner Music-
(Games Optional)
4. Toast Best Man Maid of Honor Speech …
5. 1st Dance -( Jason Maraz/ Colbie Caillat Lucky )
6. Bouquet Toss – ( Beyonce single ladies ) Garter Toss -( Rihanna- S&M )
7. Cake Cutting

8. Dance Music – Dancing
9. Last Dance Song of the Night – Bride & Groom Thank There Guests
Departure – Goodnight Sweetheart.

DO NOT PLAY- Chicken dance

*Married couples dance and we find out who has been married the longest at the reception.
